title: University of Waterloo Electric Vehicle Competition
description: Joined my high school's Electric Vehicle team and worked on telemetry, networking, and data management for our race car. It was one of my first opportunities to build software around real hardware, where reliability mattered just as much as writing code. Looking back, this experience sparked much of my interest in systems, research, and implementations beyond the classroom.
achievements: University of Waterloo EVC 2026 Event Champion
